lines.text: Imagine an AI team that does real work, and *still checks with you first*.
First, connect Google Workspace. *One click*, and no passwords to copy.
Then choose exactly which tools each AI Employee gets. Sending email? *It asks first.*
Reading is automatic. Anything risky *waits for a person*.
Now just ask, in plain words, and watch every step happen *live*.
It checks what your company already knows, then *pulls the numbers itself*.
Ravi, the manager, brings in *two specialists* to split the work.
Before an email goes out, *you decide*. Approve it straight from your inbox.
Then it finishes the job, and *every step is on record*.
AI Employees. Your AI team, *already at work*.
